data.name: AirVisible
data.value: Caption on air · press to hide (F6)

data.name: AirTip
data.value: Shows the caption on the camera and OBS or hides it: F6 anywhere in the main window; in the captions tab also Space, and Esc hides it.

data.name: ToCameraTip
data.value: The camera lower-third caption on the Axicultus output screen

data.name: SettingsTip
data.value: OBS connection · camera · scene shortcuts · browser source · recovery · PPT fine-tuning

data.name: FollowScreenTip
data.value: Follows the PPT, song, Bible passage or text on the output screen (the output panel when not live) as the caption. While the show is not on the screen, an item picked in the worship list on the caption tab goes to the output panel.

data.name: InstantTip
data.value: Korean is sent each time a syllable is complete. Enter confirms it: the box empties and the caption stays until the next one.

data.name: ShowAutoTip
data.value: Sends the score where a slide has a score picture, else the caption. (1)

data.name: ShowScoreTip
data.value: Splits the PPT score into rows (a staff and the lyrics under it) and sends one row at a time. (3)

data.name: ShowScoreTextTip
data.value: Sends a score row with its lyrics under it. (4)

data.name: SyncShow
data.value: Previous/Next turn the output screen too (sync)

data.name: SyncShowTip
data.value: When on, Previous/Next turn the output screen (PPT slides, song and Bible pages) and the caption follows. A score sends all rows of a slide before turning to the next slide.

data.name: PreviewOff
data.value: Turn on the camera preview in Settings

data.name: PreviewSizeTip
data.value: Resize the camera preview · drag to change its height

data.name: NoSteps

data.name: LinesTip
